item.tib: spral pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las kong btsun de mo'i zhu lan
item.coloph: de ltar gnas chen bon ri yi/ nyams snang rmi lam gsal sgron 'di/ dad ldan slob ma mos 'dun can/ dpal tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis/ zhu ba yang yang bskul ba byas/ zhu rten dar dang zab la byas/ zhu skyems g.yu' drung bdud rtsi grang (drangs) / zhu skabs rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i/ gar (dkar) chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ phyi rabs gang zag rjes 'breng rnams/ dad dang dang ba 'dren pa yi/ gnas kyi yon tan thob pa dang / bsgrub pa bar chod med pa dang / nyag gcig snying po don rtogs shog skad cig sangs rgyas thob nas kyang / 'gro ba sems tsan dpal gyur shog/
